findings.note: MLB.com confirms Peralta starts ALCS Game 2. It says he had a 0.96 ERA over 28 innings in five September starts, about 17 outs per start, and quotes Kevin Cash saying he has found ways to get deep in games.

In his only start this postseason, the Rays pulled Peralta after 4 2/3 innings (14 outs) while he was holding the Yankees to one run. That is just over the 13.5 line and shows Tampa Bay may pull him early even when he is pitching well.

ESPN reports that before the trade, Peralta failed to finish five innings in 15 of his 22 Mets starts, and his strikeout and whiff rates dropped. That is evidence for short outings, though it predates his run with the Rays.
